run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the minimum XOR value pair from an array of integers
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify minimum XOR pair results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to optimize the O(n squared) nested loop XOR pair search
review_f_gold: review f_gold which sorts an array then computes XOR of all pairs to find minimum
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that finds the minimum XOR value among all pairs in an integer array
